full_name: Asia-Pacific International Symposium on Aerospace Technology
organizer: Rotating among four national societies: CSAA (China), RAeS Australian Division / Engineers Australia (Australia), KSAS (Korea), JSASS (Japan)
frequency: Annual since 2009 (1st: Gifu 2009); the 2020 edition was postponed to 2021 because of COVID-19

submission.type: Abstract first (about 1 page), then a full paper; 'No Paper No Podium, No Podium No Paper'. Proceedings: Springer LNEE (2018, 2021, 2023, 2025), Engineers Australia (2015, 2019, 2024), J-STAGE / Trans. JSASS (Japan-hosted years), Procedia Engineering (2014)
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: Mid-May to late June of the conference year (2022: 23 May; 2023: 15 May; 2024: 27 Jun ext.; 2025: 30 May; 2026: 5 Jun ext.)
submission.typical_final_deadline: Full paper from late July to late August; final version about 1 month before the event (2026: 30 Sep)
submission.notes: 2026 (JST): abstract submission opened 20 Apr; abstract deadline 5 Jun (extended from 29 May); notification 17 Jun; J-STAGE paper deadline 31 Jul; final full paper deadline 30 Sep (https://smartconf.jp/content/apisat2026/). A JSASS X post gave the 2026 Call for Papers deadline as 22 May 2026 (https://x.com/jsass_jp/status/2056655592698306790), which conflicts with the official site's 29 May; the official site is used here. 2025: abstracts 1-30 May 2025, full paper 1 Aug 2025 (https://www.raes.org.au/events/conferences/apisat2025/). 2024: notification 16 Jul 2024; full paper 23 Aug 2024 extended per RAeS (the APISAT site said 16 Aug) (https://www.raes.org.au/eventdetails/24186/asia-pacific-international-symposium-on-aerospace-technology-2024). 2023: abstracts 1 Mar - 15 May 2023, full paper 7 Aug 2023 (https://www.raes.org.au/eventdetails/18396/asia-pacific-international-symposium-on-aerospace-technology). 2022: abstract 13 May, extended to 23 May 2022; full paper 15 Jul, extended to 22 Jul 2022 (https://smartconf.jp/content/apisat2022).

editions.venue: Sunport Hall Takamatsu (per the @APISAT2013 X account; not on the JSASS page)
Toyama International Conference Center / ANA Crowne Plaza Hotel (joint with the 53rd JSASS Aircraft Symposium)
Not held: postponed to 2021 (Jeju) because of COVID-19
The Westin Blue Bay Resort & Spa

notes: Edition numbering (consistent across sources): 2009 = 1st, 2015 = 7th, 2018 = 10th, 2019 = 11th, 2021 = 12th, 2022 = 13th, 2024 = 15th, 2025 = 16th, 2026 = 17th. The 2014 = 6th and 2016 = 8th labels are inferred; Crossref labels 2018 as the 9th, which conflicts with RAeS's 10th. The host rotates CSAA -> RAeS -> JSASS/KSAS. The official site apisat.org reset connections on every fetch attempt. Unverifiable fields: 2011 is not verified (rotation suggests Australia, possibly Melbourne, but no source was found). 2009, 2012 and 2014 rely on search-result text from sources I could not fetch directly (aconf CFP; a ScienceDirect paper citing 'Jeju, Korea, November 13-15, 2012'; the Procedia Engineering vol. 99 header 'APISAT2014 September 24-26, 2014 Shanghai'). 2013: the Sunport Hall venue comes only from the @APISAT2013 X account via search; 2013-06-25 is the EXTENDED abstract deadline; the manuscript deadline was extended from 13 Sep to 20 Sep 2013. 2016: JSASS lists 24-27 Oct 2016, joint with the 53rd Aircraft Symposium, so the APISAT core days may be shorter. 2018: RAeS and Springer give 16-18 Oct 2018 (the event site reportedly said 15-19 Oct including side events); venue not found. 2019: RAeS lists 'Surfers Paradise Marriot Resort', while 10times says 'JW Marriott Gold Coast Resort & Spa' (likely the same property); the 2019 proceedings were published by Engineers Australia. 2020: per apisat2021.org (via search; the site's TLS certificate had expired), a 'Notice of Postponement' dated 1 Jul 2020 moved APISAT 2020 to 2021 by agreement of the member societies, so there was no 2020 edition. 2021: hybrid format at Ramada Plaza Jeju Hotel, hosted by KSAS (Springer IJASS editorial and the apisat2021 call for papers, via search). 2024: the 27 Jun 2024 extended abstract deadline comes from apisat2024.org via search (that domain no longer resolves); RAeS confirms only that abstracts closed, with notification 16 Jul 2024. 2023 venue and deadlines are from the RAeS event page; hosts were CSAA, Tsinghua, BUAA, CAUC and the AVIC Aerodynamics Research Institute. NEXT: APISAT 2026 (Sapporo, 27-29 Oct 2026) is upcoming but its abstract deadline has passed. APISAT 2027: not announced as of 2026-10-16. An apisat.org news item on APISAT2023 (via search) quotes the KSAS president expecting to attend APISAT2027, and the rotation suggests a China (CSAA) host, but host, dates and deadline are unverified. Do not confuse APISAT with APASE 2027 (Harbin, Jan 2027), a different conference.
